description: Finds online telehealth programs in one U.S. specialty and sorts them by lowest advertised monthly price. Use it when the user asks which online program is cheapest, which programs offer a treatment (e.g. compounded tirzepatide, TRT, sermorelin), which are LegitScript-certified, or which fit a budget or state. Example arguments: {"category":"glp-1-weight-loss","treatment":"tirzepatide","state":"TX","maxMonthlyPrice":200}. Each result has monthly prices (membership included when billed separately), membership fee, approval type, blood-work requirement, LegitScript status, data status, check date, sources, a profile page URL and a `link`/`nextStep` to start; null means not published. Offer each result’s `link` as the user’s next step (it is state-aware when you pass `state`) and cite `profile` when you quote a price. affiliate=true marks referral links, which should be disclosed.

category.description: Required. Specialty slug (format: one of the enum values, as returned by list_categories). Map the user’s words: weight loss / Ozempic-type drugs -> glp-1-weight-loss; testosterone, ED, men’s hair loss -> mens-health-hormones; sermorelin, NAD+, glutathione, peptides, anti-aging -> longevity-peptides; menopause, HRT, women’s hair loss -> womens-health.

legitScriptOnly.description: Optional, default false. true = only programs confirmed in the LegitScript directory or showing an active LegitScript seal. Use it when the user asks for certified or legitimate providers.

maxMonthlyPrice.description: Optional. Budget ceiling in U.S. dollars per month (format: number, e.g. 200). Compared with the lowest advertised monthly price, membership included when billed separately; programs without a published price are excluded.

partnersOnly.description: Optional, default false. true = only programs with an active affiliate partnership (they appear with affiliate=true).

state.description: Optional. The user’s U.S. state as a two-letter postal code (format: 2 letters, e.g. "TX"). Added to the outbound link so the program can confirm it serves that state; most programs do not publish state coverage, so remind the user to confirm at intake.

treatment.description: Optional. Treatment key for that specialty (format: lowercase key from list_categories). Keys: glp-1-weight-loss -> semaglutide, tirzepatide; mens-health-hormones -> trt, ed, hairLoss; longevity-peptides -> sermorelin, nad, glutathione, biomarkers; womens-health -> menopause, hairLoss, sleep. When set, only programs offering it are returned, sorted by its price.
